bullets.text: Apple Appeals £1.5 Billion Case - **Apple** seeks to overturn a ruling on excessive App Store commissions affecting millions of UK users.

Future of Smartphones - **True Ventures** predicts smartphones will evolve significantly in the next five to ten years.

European Deep Tech Spinouts Thrive - 76 European university spinouts achieved unicorn status, showcasing the region's deep tech potential.
AI Dictation Apps Surge - 2025 marks a significant rise in **AI** dictation apps, enhancing transcription accuracy and efficiency.
Samsung Galaxy A17 Launch - The **Galaxy A17** introduces AI features at an accessible price, enhancing its appeal in the market.

Vibration Plates for Fitness - Experts weigh in on the effectiveness of vibration plates as a fitness tool for 2026.
